contribution.position: I hold my earlier position, with one new point that comes from answering ops. Ops says the rollback path is proven because artifact:restore-test-2026-08 shows a clean restore with zero data loss. That artifact is not in the provided list, and ops listed no anchors. The only artifact on the topic, artifact:ops-runbook (Runbook v4), says nightly backups are taken but a restore has never been tested. Until the restore-test record is produced and checked, I treat the ops claim as unsupported and the restore drill as still outstanding. Even if that record exists, a restore test shows backup integrity. It does not show how the service behaves when clients retry aggressively. I also answer qa: 412 passed with 0 failed (artifact:test-report) says nothing about retry or failure amplification, which is what caused both sev2 incidents in artifact:incident-log. Open items: (1) a retry-storm or fault-injection result for this change; (2) either the missing restore-test record, or one successful restore drill from the nightly backup. Both items are small and could plausibly be done this week.
